clock_in.result: passed for stalls and a restart; one observation for the owner's check
clock_in.method: build/ script (not committed): the Mac sends Start and clock at 90 bpm to the rig (its own tempo 120) while it plays the 808 Kit slot, and records the rig's USB audio; each hit is compared with the steady phase's offset from the eighth-note grid, since the recording's latency is not known. Run on v1.20.0 first, then twice on 1.21.0.
clock_in.v1_20_0: after an 800 ms stall the pattern sits 3.9 to 4.1 ticks off for good; after a stall with the missed ticks in a burst, 5.1 to 5.3 ticks off
clock_in.v1_21_0: after an 800 ms stall, and after a stall with the missed ticks in a burst, every hit stays within 0.3 tick of the steady phase (both runs); a Start while running, 10 ticks short of a bar line, plays the pattern from the top
clock_in.observation: after that Start while running, the pattern runs 2.2 to 2.6 ticks (61 to 72 ms at 90 bpm) later than before it, constant afterwards, in both 1.21.0 runs. #1110 measured the same kind of shift at about half a tick on both builds and left its cause open (possibly the recording path). The owner's looper check covers it by ear.
